description: For an order token from create_order: files the payment details (rail usdc_base, billing address with a two-letter state for the US, the wallet the buyer pays from, role, acceptance) and Beacon emails a one-time code to the buyer's own inbox (the order's email address), never to the agent. Answers the order's status.

accept.description: true only when the buyer has read and accepted the Terms of Service including Schedule C, the refund policy and the Privacy Policy (https://aruon.ai/terms-of-service, https://aruon.ai/privacy)

phone.description: the buyer's phone, if not given at create_order
